description: De Lijn - Open Data API search operations is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by De Lijn. The Open Data API search operations offers this functionalities: - Search stops by description. E.g Veemarkt or station. - Search lines by number or description. E.g search line 48 or Hamont - Search locations (x,y) by user address input. Typical for input on a routeplanner (e.g. kerkstraat 14 Hasselt or Achter De Kazerne ). Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in JSON. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
